LESSON: THE ENLIGHTENED BEINGS

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: The Enlightened Beings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Enlightened Beings. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir
   In simple words: practise until you can name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Enlightened Beings using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Enlightened Beings in the examples.
2. Explain The Enlightened Beings to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Enlightened Beings.
4. Show that you can: name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Enlightened Beings using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Enlightened Beings important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. The learner be guided to pick Beings to associate the pictures/images of themselves with the Enlightened Beings from other Enlightened Beings as per pictures as a group activity. their faith.
2. The learner be taught c) c. appreciate the Enlightened songs/stories about Paramatma Beings for divine and the Enlightened Beings knowledge.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
